headline: Space to
body_1: Hillvue Haven was designed with outdoor living at its heart. Covered alfresco areas flow naturally from the open-plan living spaces — blurring the line between inside and out.
body_2: Every residence has generous private outdoor space, beautifully landscaped and level — a place to entertain, to sit in the sun, or to simply enjoy the fresh air.
checklist: Level lawn — wheelchair and mobility aid friendly
